snippet.title: Petri Party Trailer - a chaotic action platformer couch party game
snippet.description:
Petri Party - a chaotic action platformer couch party game that supports up to 18 players, with both PvP and campaign modes.
Are you a fan of Liero, Spiderheck or Soldat? You would enjoy this.
The game will have an early access release on the 11th of December.
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4215680/Petri_Party/
